hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ "$FILE" == *.dart ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.g.dart ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.freezed.dart ]] && command -v dart &>/dev/null; then echo "[Harness] Dart 파일 변경 감지 → dart analyze 실행 중..."; dart analyze "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
if command -v flutter &>/dev/null && [ -f "pubspec.yaml" ]; then echo "[Harness] 작업 완료 전 flutter test 실행 중..."; flutter test 2>&1 | tail -30; fi
